component.name: IPTV Player
component.summary: Watch IPTV channels, movies and series with VLC playback

description.p: A desktop IPTV client for Xtream Codes and M3U providers. It organises a provider's flat channel list into a TV / Movies / Series tree, plays through VLC's engine in an embedded window, downloads movies and episodes for offline viewing, and fetches subtitles from OpenSubtitles using the same keyless protocol as VLC's VLSub extension.
Built for large catalogs: tens of thousands of items are kept in SQLite and rendered through virtualized views, so memory stays flat no matter how big the list is.
VLC must be installed separately — this player uses its decoding engine but does not redistribute VideoLAN's binaries.
Fullscreen on Windows 11 no longer shows a hairline of desktop along the screen's edges or through its corners.

A Netflix-style homepage mixing channels, films and shows in one wall of rows, fully keyboard-navigable, arrangeable, and pageable as you scroll. Shows get their own page with resumable episodes, a seasons tab strip and the same keyboard navigation. A master search across the whole catalog, an "up next" prompt between episodes, and the mouse wheel now changes the volume over the video.
Picture-in-Picture: shrink the window to a small player that stays above other applications, with controls that appear on hover.

VLC's keyboard controls: left and right arrows seek ten seconds, up and down arrows change the volume, and space reliably plays and pauses. A clear message when the installed VLC does not match the app's processor architecture.
Full VLC control bar, keyless VLSub subtitles, daily catalog updates and resumable downloads.
